recommendation: Keep the audit commit for core. If FHIR-I still wants per-test traceability to individual Requirements.statement.key values in the redesigned TestPlan model, handle that follow-up in HL7/fhir-testing-ig rather than in the core FHIR checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-42720 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-I. It requested a computable way for TestPlan test cases to point to an individual Requirements.statement.key; the final resolution used a canonical(Requirements) reference plus a key rather than a plain Reference.
initial_application: FHIR-I discussed the canonical/reference question on 2024-04-01 and approved FHIR-42720 on 2024-04-15 by Richard Ettema / Yunwei Wang 10-0-0. Commit c73f9fd93553d43f5069797c458fc0ebe6c98d6c, merged by PR #3070 as af86b789611b3bddb6ca80c2ad12ca85988a61cb, added TestPlan.testCase.requirement.reference canonical(Requirements) and TestPlan.testCase.requirement.key id to source/testplan/structuredefinition-TestPlan.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-50901 later made the Applied/Persuasive R6 decision that the existing TestPlan was insufficient and should be reworked using the Tooling IG TestCases structure; commit 80ac210e33dd10b2582e5bbcea1000bf4d4fabb4 implemented that redesign and removed the old TestPlan.testCase requirement backbone. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 then removed TestPlan, TestReport, and TestScript from active core source and added a pointer to the FHIR Testing IG. Current source/fhir.ini has no TestPlan resource entry, source/testplan is absent, and core ballot narrative links TestPlan to the external Testing IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. The current core checkout has no build-scope TestPlan StructureDefinition source to edit, so reintroducing TestPlan.testCase.requirement in core would be incorrect.

related_jiras.note: Same PR and commit added TestPlan.testCase.key/description alongside the FHIR-42720 requirement backbone; it already has an external-repo audit commit on the combined branch.
Companion TestScript issue used the same canonical Requirements plus statement key design and already has an external-repo audit commit on the combined branch.
Later Applied/Persuasive TestPlan rework replaced the prior testCase-centric model modified by FHIR-42720.
Later TestPlan nesting work touched the same old TestPlan.testCase area before the broader FHIR-50901 rework.
